rules.aggregate: At least 95/100 overall and 23/25 in each of slow, medium, fast and start_stop, independently in each backend.
rules.horizon: The planned and completed horizons are at least 60 s; early termination fails.
rules.steady_walk: At least 4 s and six valid alternating steps after command settling.
rules.tracking: RMS heading-frame forward and lateral velocity errors over settled moving samples.
rules.heading: Maximum absolute unwrapped pelvis-yaw change from the frozen initial heading.
rules.tilt: Peak tilt is always checked; tilt above 15 degrees continuously for 0.2 s fails.
rules.stop: Maximum post-settle horizontal-speed RMS and displacement from each stop segment's settled start.
rules.gait: Worst speed-segment cadence and step-length relative errors, bilateral asymmetry, alternation and tiny-step fraction.
rules.slip: Force-weighted physical contact-point slip RMS and sample p95 over settled moving stance.
rules.contact: Unmatched expected/actual contact fraction and bilateral-flight fraction over settled walking.
rules.safety: Nonfinite state, fall, forbidden non-foot ground contact, missing metrics or insufficient evidence fail closed.
